column4: Dispatches one 0x100-byte scheduler API frame: hdr low nibble must be 1 (MES_API_TYPE_SCHEDULER), opcode = hdr>>4&0xff (MES_SCH_API_*).\nThe frame ring has 32 slots at ctx+8+slot*0x100; rptr/wptr live at ctx+0x31a8 / ctx+0x31a4.
Records (opcode, phase 0=begin/1=end, status) of an API call in the MES trace log.
Writes api_status.api_completion_fence_value to api_completion_fence_addr (frame offsets +0x10 / +8) and optionally raises an interrupt.
